The jmp_buf* is a host-runtime object. It cannot cross ABI 7
For ABI 7 to be load-bearing in parseCompoundStatementInternal,
the PolyC component would have to either:
(a) install its own jmp_buf on the host cc, requiring a callback
to a host function that mutates cc->current_recovery,
(b) accept a callback table of subordinate parsers and reject the
host setjmp semantics (which breaks the contract that recovery
from subordinate parseStatement failures unwinds back here),
(c) own the entire recovery protocol end-to-end, including the
subordinate parsers -- which contradicts PARSER01 DEFERRED_PARSER_SURFACES
